messages:
sana: Quick heads-up — preparing to roll out `sensitive_logging_v2` in audit mode. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/sensitive-logging/pull/412. Need a quick check: scope (tenant-level vs global), KMS/HSM path fallback, retention guardrails and canary plan. Proposed rollout: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~3 days. Who can ✍️ on security/legal sign-off?
marco: skimmed the PR. Is the flag tenant-scoped or org-scoped? important for customers that opted out previously.
sana: tenant-scoped. targeting tenants with tag `compliance: pii` for initial canary. Snippet from config:```yaml
rollout:
  target_tag: "compliance:pii"
  steps:
    - {percent: 1, duration: "2h"}
    - {percent: 5, duration: "4h"}
    - {percent: 25, duration: "24h"}
    - {percent: 100, duration: "72h"}
fallback:
  kms_primary: "cloud-kms"
  hsm_fallback: "customer-hsm"
retention:
  default_days: 30
  max_days: 365
  audit_copy_days: 180
```
joe_platt: on KMS/HSM — for EU tenants we should prefer HSM for audit retrievals. PR shows primary=KMS, HSM fallback. Is rotation/privilege separation covered?
sana: yes. writes go to cloud-kms always. audit retrieval path will attempt `customer-hsm` if tenant.has_hsm == true, otherwise use cloud-kms. rotation: keys are rotated per tenant per our KMS policy; HSM keys require tenant onboarding. Privilege separation: audit-read role is separate and logged.
amy_security: retention numbers look reasonable, but legal needs to confirm max/audit durations. Also request adding an approval gate for retention overrides >90 days.
tara_legal: please add a documented data flow diagram and a retention table in the PR. We need an explicit opt-out for EU data subjects and a note on data subject requests (DSR) handling. I can sign off once those are in place.
marco: please add metrics/alerts. Suggest: `sensitive_logging_audit_hooks_total` and `sensitive_logging_audit_error_rate`. Alert if audit hooks >0.5% of total requests or if error_rate >0.2% for 5m.
sana: added metrics to PR and included alert rules. Also added a quick smoke test for tail latency.
eng-oncall: I can run perf tests today. prefer canary start at 1% for 2h, observe p95. If tail latency increases >50ms or error >0.2% rollback immediately.
sana: updated rollout plan accordingly: 1% (2h) -> 5% (4h) -> 25% (24h) -> 100%. Rollback conditions: p95 delta >50ms OR error_rate >0.2% sustained for 5m.
marco: :thumbsup: I'll approve once you add changelog and config validation (schema check). Also include a note about telemetry retention so OPS can purge test artifacts.
sana: noted. adding changelog entry and JSON schema validation in CI. Also adding a small script in PR for purge:```bash
# purge test artifacts for tenant
./tools/purge_audit_artifacts --tenant-id $TID --before $(date -d '7 days ago' +%F)
```
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: `sensitive_logging_v2` -> canary(1%) at 2026-04-06T14:00Z (automated roll planner).
amy_security: one more ask — add a daily audit report email for retained audit copies >30d to security@redwood so we can review exceptions.
sana: done — report added and will attach data flow diagram + retention table to PR. Thanks everyone — I'll post updates to #eng-runtime during rollout and ping when we hit each stage.
